analyst_view.overall: Hajduk Split (13th, 6 pts) host Sint-Truiden (10th, 7 pts) with both close to the knockout places: local press says a Hajduk win would all but secure a play-off spot, and a point would do much the same for Sint-Truiden, whose new coach Jonas De Roeck (in charge for about three weeks) says he would be happy with one. Poljud is closed to regular fans after pyrotechnics against Ajax; about 8,000 invited children from sports academies will sit in the east stand and Sint-Truiden's own fans are not travelling in numbers. Gonzalo Garcia has everyone except Brajkovic, Ivusic and Livaja (counted), and centre-back Hadzikadunic recovered faster than expected and could start, with Soticek and Sanyang back after a rest. Sint-Truiden report no absentees, rely on top scorer Ilias Sebaoui, and both clubs play again on Sunday. Italian referee Matteo Marchetti is named, and the numbers already trim cards about 7% for his record.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals (1.5 Hajduk, 1.6 Sint-Truiden), with both sides' recent scoring in the momentum adjustment and Livaja's absence on the list. Hajduk are close to full strength at both ends with Hadzikadunic, Soticek and Sanyang back, and Sint-Truiden have no injuries, so nothing points clearly up or down and I stay at 3.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.5 corners, split evenly, with Hajduk's recent corner count nudged up and Sint-Truiden's down by momentum. Soticek and Sanyang back on the wings helps Hajduk's wide play, while Sint-Truiden's pressing and runs in behind are more about quick attacks than crosses, so the two cancel out and I stay at 8.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.4 cards, already trimmed for referee Marchetti's low card record (-7%) and both sides' recent counts. I keep a small lean lower, to about 3.3: with Poljud closed to regular fans and only invited children in the stands, there is far less crowd pressure on players and referee, which the numbers can't see. Sint-Truiden's high press could bring a few tactical fouls, which keeps the size small.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots. Sint-Truiden's busy attacking and Hajduk's tight recent defending are both in the momentum adjustment; Garcia expects an open game against a pressing side, but Hajduk's returning players only bring them back to their usual strength, so I stay at 26.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target, already trimmed for Hajduk conceding few on target lately (Sint-Truiden -7%). Hadzikadunic's return strengthens Hajduk's defence but he was part of the side that built that record, and Livaja's absence is counted, so nothing new changes how often either keeper is tested and I stay at 9.0.
